021public class CombatListenerUtil {
022        
023        public static List<String> modifyDamageDealt(Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
024                                                                                         DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
025                return modifyDamageDealt(Global.getCombatEngine().getListenerManager().getListeners(DamageDealtModifier.class),
026                                                                 param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
027        }
028        
029        public static List<String> modifyDamageDealt(ShipAPI attacker, Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
030                                                                                                 DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
031                if (attacker == null || attacker.getListenerManager() == null) return null;
032                return modifyDamageDealt(attacker.getListeners(DamageDealtModifier.class), param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
033        }
034        
035        protected static List<String> modifyDamageDealt(List<DamageDealtModifier> mods, Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
036                                                                                                 DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
037                List<String> ids = null;
038                mods = new ArrayList<DamageDealtModifier>(mods);
039                for (DamageDealtModifier x : mods) {
040                        String id = x.modifyDamageDealt(param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
041                        if (id != null) {
042                                if (ids == null) ids = new ArrayList<String>();
043                                ids.add(id);
044                        }
045                }
046                return ids;
047        }
048        
049        
050        
051        
052        public static List<String> modifyDamageTaken(Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
053                                                                                                 DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
054                return modifyDamageTaken(Global.getCombatEngine().getListenerManager().getListeners(DamageTakenModifier.class),
055                                                                param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
056        }
057
058        public static List<String> modifyDamageTaken(ShipAPI ship, Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
059                                                                                                 DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
060                // ship == target, yes
061                if (ship == null || ship.getListenerManager() == null) return null;
062                return modifyDamageTaken(ship.getListeners(DamageTakenModifier.class), param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
063        }
064
065        protected static List<String> modifyDamageTaken(List<DamageTakenModifier> mods, Object param, CombatEntityAPI target, 
066                                                                                                        DamageAPI damage, Vector2f point, boolean shieldHit) {
067                List<String> ids = null;
068                mods = new ArrayList<DamageTakenModifier>(mods);
069                for (DamageTakenModifier x : mods) {
070                        String id = x.modifyDamageTaken(param, target, damage, point, shieldHit);
071                        if (id != null) {
072                                if (ids == null) ids = new ArrayList<String>();
073                                ids.add(id);
074                        }
075                }
076                return ids;
077        }
078
079        public static void reportDamageApplied(ShipAPI ship, Object source, CombatEntityAPI target, ApplyDamageResultAPI result) {
080                for (DamageListener x : new ArrayList<DamageListener>(Global.getCombatEngine().getListenerManager().getListeners(DamageListener.class))) {
081                        x.reportDamageApplied(source, target, result);
082                }
083                if (ship != null) {
084                        for (DamageListener x : new ArrayList<DamageListener>(ship.getListeners(DamageListener.class))) {
085                                x.reportDamageApplied(source, target, result);
086                        }
087                }
088        }
089        
090        public static boolean notifyAboutToTakeHullDamage(ShipAPI ship, Object source, Vector2f point, float damageAmount) {
091                boolean result = false;
092                for (HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener x : new ArrayList<HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener>(Global.getCombatEngine().getListenerManager().getListeners(HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener.class))) {
093                        result |= x.notifyAboutToTakeHullDamage(source, ship, point, damageAmount);
094                }
095                for (HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener x : new ArrayList<HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener>(ship.getListeners(HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener.class))) {
096                        result |= x.notifyAboutToTakeHullDamage(source, ship, point, damageAmount);
097                }
098                return result;
099        }

101        public static float getWeaponRangePercentMod(ShipAPI ship, WeaponAPI weapon) {
102                float mod = 0f;
103                if (ship != null) {
104                        for (WeaponRangeModifier x : new ArrayList<WeaponRangeModifier>(ship.getListeners(WeaponRangeModifier.class))) {
105                                mod += x.getWeaponRangePercentMod(ship, weapon);
106                        }
107                }
108                return mod;
109        }
110        
111        public static float getWeaponRangeMultMod(ShipAPI ship, WeaponAPI weapon) {
112                float mod = 1f;
113                if (ship != null && ship.getListenerManager() != null) {
114                        for (WeaponRangeModifier x : new ArrayList<WeaponRangeModifier>(ship.getListeners(WeaponRangeModifier.class))) {
115                                mod *= x.getWeaponRangeMultMod(ship, weapon);
116                        }
117                }
118                return mod;
119        }
